parts.title: Part B — A briefing
parts.instructions: Read the text and answer the questions.

shared.title: Summit compliance briefing
shared.text: If our cooperative had not filed the complaint last month, the operator would have kept canceling our confirmed bookings. The account, which is now under compliance review, has been flagged, so no rebooking is possible until it is cleared. It is highly probable that the cancellation fees will be waived once the audit is complete. The delegation is likely to arrive at approximately nine forty; a revised schedule is being circulated. On the one hand the delay is frustrating; on the other hand, the review protects every member of the network.

questions.prompt: What would have happened without the complaint?

options.text: the operator would have kept canceling the bookings

questions.prompt: Why is no rebooking possible right now?

options.text: because the account has been flagged and is under review

questions.prompt: What is highly probable once the audit ends?

options.text: the cancellation fees will be waived

questions.prompt: When is the delegation likely to arrive?
How does the writer balance the situation?

options.text: with a pros-and-cons contrast (on the one hand… on the other hand…)

questions.prompt: Formal complaint / claim letter to an OTA (120-160 words). Write a formal complaint letter to an international OTA. The cooperative's account has been blocked and the operator has been cancelling confirmed bookings. Explain the problem (present perfect / present perfect continuous), demand concrete actions assertively (I am writing to request..., we require that...) and ask for the cancellation fees to be waived (might be waived).

Choose ONE: (a) Chair's meeting summary OR (b) 'Colombia, a Mediator's Perspective' (120-160 words). (a) the chair's summary of a negotiation: opens the session, summarises positions, records the disagreement (we strongly disagree) and closes on time; or (b) the climate defence 'Colombia, a Mediator's Perspective': integrate advanced conditionals (If we had not integrated..., ... would be...) and compound passive (has been protected, would be closed).

questions.text: Write your text here. Choose option (a) or option (b).
